snippet.title: Tomo The Wildcat (Azumanga Daioh Fangame) - Trailer 2 + Demo Download
snippet.description:
Just in for Azuma's birthday, presenting a new trailer of Tomo The Wildcat (Azumanga Daioh Fan game) along with a downloadable demo with a few levels!

Download Demo: https://lukasatbk.itch.io/tomo-the-wildcat
-New release date: July 25th, 2025-
